newsitem.title: USA: Roberts drug gets priority review in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Roberts drug gets priority review in Canada.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said on Thursday its new drug Agrylin, to reduce high blood platelet count, has received "priority review" status by the Canadian Health Protection Branch.
Roberts also said it planned to file a product license application for Agrylin under procedures to get the drug approved within the European Community.

Roberts said it filed a New Drug Submission for Agrylin with the Canadian regulatory agency after recent U.S. Food and Drug Administration notification that the product was "approvable" in the United States to treat thrombocythemia.

The Canadian Health Protection branch, in considering granting expeditious review of the drug, said it "is a novel chemical entity that appears to reduce platelet count and represents an important therapeutic gain over current therapies including radioactive phosphorus, cytotoxic agents and alfa interferon," Roberts quoted.
The company said it also recently met the European Medicines Evaluation Agency.
